changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Temporary atomic handoff of organization configuration facts to future CDC. Not an archive or retry-history table. No cleanup is enabled before capture acceptance.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE kabipay_ops.organization_outbox ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, organization_id UUID REFERENCES kabipay_ops.organization(id), source_tenant_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kabipay_ops.tenant(id), actor_principal_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kabipay_ops.principal(id), aggregate_id UUID NOT NULL, aggregate_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (aggregate_version > 0), event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL CHECK (event_type ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*$'), schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version = 1), payload JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() ); CREATE INDEX idx_organization_outbox_capture ON kabipay_ops.organization_outbox(created_at,id);
